name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A set of design rules and commands you give your AI coding assistant so the websites and apps it builds don't all look like the same generic AI-made template.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small agency using AI coding tools to build client sites, tired of every AI-generated design looking like the same purple-gradient SaaS template.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it so every AI-assisted client site ships with distinct, on-brand visual design instead of the generic template look, justifying higher rates.
A small design-forward dev agency uses the 'extract' and 'document' commands to build a reusable design system from an existing client codebase, then resells design-consistency audits.
An indie SaaS founder runs '/impeccable critique' and '/impeccable audit' before launch to catch obvious AI-template tells without hiring a designer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'de-slop your AI app' audit service: run the tool's critique and audit commands against a client's AI-built site and deliver a fix list.
Sell a premium, brand-specific extension pack of design rules tailored to an agency's house style, licensed per seat.

steal_this: This weekend, run '/impeccable audit' and '/impeccable critique' against three local businesses' AI-built websites and pitch each one a paid fix-up pass.
